solutions.title: Clean Energy Engineering for Every Scale
solutions.subtitle: From turnkey industrial solar installations to distributed hybrid telecom backups, we provide the hardware foundation for energy autonomy.
solutions.commercialRooftopDesc: High-density N-Type bifacial solar panels configured for export factories, commercial warehouses, and garment mills seeking zero peak-tariff overhead.
solutions.batteryBackupDesc: Deep-cycle 6,000+ cycle lithium-iron phosphate battery banks designed for reliable overnight shift operation, telecom towers, and data centers.
solutions.inverterArchitectureDesc: Parallelable 3-phase hybrid inverters with millisecond grid-to-battery transfer time, smart generator management, and remote cloud telemetry.

whyUs.title: Why Commercial Contractors Choose Noor Solar
whyUs.subtitle: We eliminate middlemen to bring tier-1 engineering solar components directly to Bangladeshi installers and project developers.
whyUs.tier1DirectDesc: Factory-direct container shipments with full bill of lading transparency, authentic factory serial codes, and original flash test reports.
whyUs.warrantySupportDesc: Central warehouse spare parts availability, warranty replacement units in Dhaka, and direct manufacturer engineering support.
whyUs.logisticsReadinessDesc: Readily available stock in our central commercial depot with same-day truck loading for industrial zones across Bangladesh.
whyUs.engineeringLiaisonDesc: Qualified electrical engineers on staff to review single-line diagrams, string sizing calculations, and battery capacity plans.

impact.title: Engineered for Extreme Durability & Lowest LCOE
impact.subtitle: Solar equipment engineered to endure Bangladesh's tropical humidity, monsoon rain, and extreme ambient heat while delivering maximum kilowatt-hour yield.
impact.humidityResistantDesc: Double-glass bifacial modules and conformal-coated inverter PCBs withstand salt mist, dust accumulation, and 95%+ relative humidity without degradation.
impact.levelizedCostDesc: High bifaciality coefficients and ultra-low annual degradation (≤0.4%/year) deliver higher cumulative power generation over 30 operational years.
impact.safetyFirstDesc: Integrated Rapid Shutdown (RSD), Arc Fault Circuit Interruption (AFCI Type 1), and Aerosol Fire Suppression built into lithium battery cabinets.

process.title: Order in Four Simple Steps
process.subtitle: A straightforward procurement workflow engineered for commercial contractors, installers, and B2B buyers across Bangladesh.
process.step1Desc: Tell us the equipment models and quantities you require via our online portal, phone call, or direct WhatsApp message.
process.step2Desc: Our commercial sales engineers verify compatibility, single-line diagrams, and datasheet requirements with your engineering team.
process.step3Desc: Receive a detailed B2B quotation with FOB/CIF or warehouse-pickup pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
process.step4Desc: Pick up directly from our Dhaka warehouse or arrange container truck dispatch directly to your commercial project site.
